integrity: The universal inequality, asymptotic construction and scale-necessity statements are supported by the analytic proof. The Python verifier supplies finite supplementary tests, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only the family GP(n,2), n at least 13, nonnegative independently chosen symmetric edge conductances, unit edge prices and total budget n; a two-term asymptotic optimum is proved, not exact finite-n optimal allocations. An equivalent specialist result could remain unlocated.
title: Sharp two-scale spectral-gap design on generalized Petersen networks
